hero.title: Hi, I'm
hero.subtitle: Software & AI Engineer at Hefex Labs and M.Sc. Informatics student at TUM.
hero.description: I build practical software and computer-vision systems with as little unnecessary complexity as possible.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a software engineer from California, now based in Munich. Before starting my Master's at TUM, I spent more than two years at Systems Planning and Analysis in San Diego. I developed Java-based analysis software and later led its user-driven roadmap and release process.
about.p2: I recently completed my TUM Interdisciplinary Project with Hefex Labs, where I built computer-vision pipelines and integrated segmentation models into an applied system. I now continue that work part-time as a Software & AI Engineer while pursuing my M.Sc. in Informatics at TUM.
about.p3: I've been coding since I was a kid, and I still build side projects whenever a problem catches my attention. I like systems that are easy to understand, hard to misuse, and no more complex than the job requires.
about.p4: I work in English and German. The best way to reach me is on LinkedIn.

rmfindr.title: RmFindr
rmfindr.desc: Indoor-positioning prototype that learns Wi-Fi signal fingerprints to estimate live location. Streams filtered RSSI scans through a FastAPI/WebSocket backend and KNN localizer to a React map.

timeSeriesAnnotator.title: Time Series Annotator
timeSeriesAnnotator.desc: Cross-platform Java desktop tool to visualize and annotate multivariate time-series (CSV/HDF5) for Tandem Diabetes Care; supports linked, resizable charts (line/step/scatter), zoom/pan, and import/export of annotations.

eduComic.title: EduComic
eduComic.desc: Hackathon-winning classroom storytelling prototype that turns lesson materials into source-grounded comics starring fictional student avatars. Built by a five-person team during START Munich's 24-hour hackathon.

stocker.title: Stocker
stocker.desc: Stock predicting site using AWS Forecast, Python + Flask, with an HTML CSS JS frontend, winner of "Most Complete Solution" at LPL Financial's 2023 Hackathon.

videoPlayer.title: Video Player
videoPlayer.desc: Lightweight Java desktop video player for The Office that catalogs episodes with descriptions, plays via VLCJ, and remembers your last-watched episode and timestamp; metadata was populated via a Selenium scraper.

embeddedSnake.title: Embedded Snake Game
embeddedSnake.desc: From-scratch Snake for STM32: joystick controls, 8×8 LED display, and lightweight sound, driven by a tight game loop and a linked-list snake.

hackathon.title: Hackathon Winner — Stocker
hackathon.desc: Won first place in LPL Financial's 24-hour hackathon with a stock prediction web app using AWS Forecast, Python (Flask), Natural Language Processing for news article sentiment analysis, and a custom HTML/CSS/JS frontend.

hackathon2.title: Hackathon Winner — EduComic
hackathon2.desc: Built in 24 hours by a five-person team, EduComic won the Black Forest Labs challenge at START Munich's hackathon. The working demo turned lesson materials into source-grounded comics using FLUX.2 and OpenAI.

hackathon3.title: Hackathon 2nd Place — CMats
hackathon3.desc: Won 2nd place in the Comstruct challenge with CMats, a voice agent system that lets construction foremen order C-materials like screws, bolts, and gloves, paired with a management platform for construction site overview and order tracking.
